reviews.summary: HOT is in an active, newly launched HOT→HoloFuel redemption transition as of November 1, 2026, with operational responsibility assigned from Holo Limited to Net Zero FZC. This is a material asset-lifecycle and counterparty change.
materialRisks: A live HOT-to-HoloFuel redemption mechanism began after Holo Limited assigned redemption responsibilities to Net Zero FZC on November 1, 2026; this is a direct, material change to HOT’s lifecycle and market context. ([holo.host](https://holo.host/resources/schedule1notice))

The swap operator is a new entity operating under a provisional Zanzibar Digital Free Zone licence, creating current execution, regulatory, and counterparty uncertainty around the transition. ([holo.host](https://holo.host/blog/progress-on-the-1-november-launch-6i3nYophVKx/))

facts.fact: Holo Limited’s November 1 notice states that HOT holders may redeem at 1 HOT for 1 HoloFuel, with the mechanism operated by Net Zero FZC. ([holo.host](https://holo.host/resources/schedule1notice))

Holo’s October 29 update said legal documentation and regulatory elements were still being finalized; its November 1 update says the swap is operated under a provisional licence. ([holo.host](https://holo.host/blog/progress-on-the-1-november-launch-6i3nYophVKx/))
Holo’s official status page reports Marketplace, Gateway, REST API, and Dashboard operational; no current project-service outage was found. ([status.holo.ag](https://status.holo.ag/))
